reason: I don't go looking in an app for this -- I post in our apartment WhatsApp group and book whoever a neighbour already vouches for. That person comes with proof I trust for free; an app I've never heard of, with only a handful of bookings near me so far, doesn't give me that.
objection: The pay-on-delivery protection is a nice safety net, but it doesn't tell me the freelancer is actually good at the job -- it just tells me I get my money back if they're bad. My neighbour's recommendation already tells me they're good, without any of that hassle.
would_change_my_mind: If two or three people in my own building's WhatsApp group had actually booked someone through hithozha and said it went well, I'd try it -- right now it just feels like it's built for English-speaking city people, not for how we actually find people here.
